brief:
Israeli consumers spent 731.33 million shekels through direct debit card transactions between 8 a.m. and 2 p.m. on election day, according to Ma'an Wire. The spending figure covered the six-hour window during voting hours.

The transaction volume suggests continued economic activity amid the electoral process, with Israelis making purchases through electronic payment methods during the morning and early afternoon voting period.
title: Israeli voters spend $731m on debit cards during election day
